name: Topscore Fashion Co., Ltd.
summary: Topscore Fashion Co., Ltd. engages in the production and sales of leather shoes and apparel products, and the mobile Internet marketing services in China. It offers mid-to-high-end fashion women's shoes, and apparel accessories under the KISSCAT, ZSAZSAZSU, tigrisso, MUSTHAVE, KissKitty, O bag, and Patricia brands. The company also offers mobile Internet media advertising, such as mobile application distribution and promotion; technical services, housing rental; and programmatic delivery of mobile Internet advertisements. Topscore Fashion Co., Ltd. was founded in 2004 and is headquartered in Guangzhou, China.
